newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - DnB 9-mo result seen flat.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - DnB 9-mo result seen flat.

text.p: Den norske Bank, Norway's biggest commercial bank, is expected to report a nine-month net profit of 2,070 million crowns, according to eight analysts polled by Reuters.
The comparative year-ago period was 2,092 million crowns.
Three analysts said buy, four said hold and one recommended to sell DnB shares.

Analysts on the buy side said DnB's strong position in market segments other than core business was important for their positive view on the bank. Narrowing interest margins have put pressure on banks to increase profits from other than net interest income.
Analysts with hold or sell recommendations said the share's potential had largely been discounted for in the short term. DnB stock has risen by more than 30 percent since the start of 1996.
Some analyst said DnB's fight with authorities over tax losses-carried forward also put a questionmark on the bank.
DnB will present the nine-month results on Thursday at 0800GMT.
